_meta.model: entity = role + structure + function + cash_flow_in + cash_flow_out + risk_level
_meta.principle: Entities are functions in a system, not types. 5 roles: CONTROL, OPERATIONS, EXPERIMENTATION, CAPITAL, PROTECTION.

roles.CONTROL: Ownership layer — holds equity, allocates capital, defines succession.
roles.OPERATIONS: Execution layer — runs the business, signs contracts, employs people.
roles.EXPERIMENTATION: Risk-isolation layer — single deal/project, contained blast radius.
roles.CAPITAL: Money-movement layer — treasury, factoring, investment vehicles.
roles.PROTECTION: Legal/risk firewall — trusts, IP holding, asset isolation.

entities.name: The Johns Family Trust
entities.function: Holds ownership interest in the holding company; shields assets, defines succession.

entities.name: Worldwidebro Holdings
entities.function: Parent brand. Owns operating entities + IP. Allocates capital across OPCOs by capital-layer margin.

entities.name: Winners Circle WC LLC
entities.function: Active legal entity. Contracts, banking, payroll, venture operations run through this TODAY.

entities.name: Worldwidebro IP Holding (proposed)
entities.function: Owns brand, trademarks, code, systems. Licenses IP down to OPCOs — keeps crown jewels out of the exposed operating entity.
entities.status: Proposed (form when first asset has value)

entities.name: Treasury / Factoring Vehicle (proposed)
entities.function: Holds cash reserves, runs invoice factoring for service OPCOs (Layer 1), routes capital to acquisitions (Layer 3).

entities.name: OPCO (operating company template, x18)
entities.structure: LLC (C-Corp election optional for VC-track OPCOs)
entities.function: One per sector group (Financial, Construction, Technology...). Houses the ventures in that sector.

entities.name: SPV (deal/project isolation template)
entities.function: One per high-risk deal/client contract/acquisition. Contains liability so a single failure cannot reach the OPCO or holding.
cash_flow_out: profit to parent OPCO on close
entities.status: Template (spawn per deal, dissolve on close)

red_team_rules: Every entity MUST have a non-empty function, cash_flow_in, and cash_flow_out — a holding layer with no cash flow is a dead structure.
IP and cash reserves live in 'isolated' entities, never in 'exposed' operating entities.
SPVs are spawned per deal and dissolved on close — never reused across unrelated deals (compliance risk).
Do not mix CAPITAL-role vehicles (treasury/factoring) with future VC/prop activity in one entity (regulatory exposure).
Do not form an entity until it has a real cash flow or a real asset to protect.
